name: v1.0.13 — Fix Volume Cap Bypass Crash & Strict Ear Protection
body:
## 🔊 Volume Limiter Stability & Crash Fixes
- **Fix Bypass Crash**: Fixed crash occurring when the Android volume system attempts to adjust volume past the max volume cap set in Parental Guide.
- **Self-Trigger & Loop Protection**: Added debounce handler and re-entrancy protection to ContentObserver and BroadcastReceiver to eliminate volume enforcement notification loops.
- **DND SecurityException Protection**: Wrapped all audio stream volume checks in isolated try-catch blocks to prevent crashes on Do Not Disturb or system-restricted streams.
- **Unified Volume Cap**: Added centralized `getMaxAllowedVolume` in `PreferencesManager` ensuring consistent mathematical clamping across the service, activities, and sliders.
- **Seekbar Drag Clamping**: Quick settings volume slider in `MainActivity` and video player swipe volume now actively clamp to the parental limit, preventing desync or slider fighting.
- **Stock UI Lockdown**: Removed `FLAG_SHOW_UI` from Touch Orb quick volume buttons to prevent revealing stock Android volume controls to children.
